First, determine UTC offsets:  
Asia/Shanghai in 1715 likely used UTC+8 (modern standard).  
Europe/London in 1715 used local mean time (approx UTC-0:01:15 historically), but for simplicity, treat as UTC+0 (Greenwich Mean Time).  

Conversion:  
London time = Shanghai time − (8 hours)  
02:00 − 8 hours = 18:00 previous day (May 13).  

FINAL_ANSWER: May 13, 18:00
